# has parent

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasParent`](gmeow-hasParent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasParent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/genealogy`](../../slices/genealogy.md)

Relates a person to a parent (any kind: biological, adoptive, step, or foster). Non-functional: contested parentage claims from multiple sources coexist as standpoint-indexed statements ([`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md)), never collapsing to a single winner ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md) -> [`gmeow:Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:connectsTo`](gmeow-connectsTo.md), [`gmeow:hasAncestor`](gmeow-hasAncestor.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasParent`](gmeow-hasParent.md) from [`gmeow:Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md) to [`gmeow:Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
